answer: In the dawn of agent registration, a summit of economic safeguards emerges from the meadow of bonded identities. New agents must deposit a 5,000 POA stake bond from an established account into escrow. The bond is slashed 20% for each failed grading round. Established agents attest new identities by signing a nonce challenge. Creating 500 fake identities burns 2.5 million POA and takes 30 days of verification work. It works like a fortified meadow gate that admits only verified agents.
